en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing an open square bordered by multi‑storey buildings with shops on the ground floors. People walk and cycle across the square, some cars are visible, and in the distance a large lake can be seen between the buildings. The architecture includes an ornate corner building with a tower and cupola on the right and more modern, simpler facades on the left. Text is printed along the bottom margin identifying the view and numbering the card, and a photographer/publisher signature appears in the lower right corner.
